title: Founding GTM Lead
description:
**Klaimee** is building liability coverage for the mistakes and failures of AI agents. We are a Y Combinator company backed by insurance capacity from-rated Bermuda-based partner, which powers our first product: a warranty for AI agent failures. Every company deploying AI agents will need this. Nobody owns the category yet.

Find Klaimee’s repeatable go-to-market motion - then own it. We sell through three possible channels: insurance brokers, embedded partners (AI platforms and agent frameworks bundling our insurance), and direct to companies deploying agents. Your first year is channel discovery: run all three motions, read the data, and tell us where to double down. This is a founder-track role - you are defining our GTM strategy, not executing someone else’s playbook.

## **What you’ll own**

* **Direct sales.** Prospect, pitch, and close companies deploying AI agents. Own the full cycle from first call to signed coverage - and turn what you learn into our sales playbook.
* **Broker channel.** Build relationships with brokers who serve AI-native companies; make Klaimee the product they reach for when clients ask about AI agent risk.
* **Partnerships.** Originate embedded distribution deals with AI platforms, agent frameworks, and marketplaces - warranty as a feature of their offering.
* **Numbers.** Targets are set together and revised as we learn - but this role carries a number from day one.

## **What success looks like in 12 months**

* We know which channel repeats - backed by closed deals, not theory - and have a written playbook for it. And you’ve hired 
* A real pipeline exists across all three motions, with revenue and signed partnerships we can show investors.
* Founders are out of first position on day-to-day selling.
* You’ve earned the case to lead the GTM team we hire next - and helped define who those hires should be.

## **Who you are**

* 3–8 years in B2B go-to-market, including zero-to-one revenue: founding AE, early GTM hire, or ex-founder who sold their own product.
* You’ve run at least two of the three motions - direct sales, channel/broker, partnerships - with evidence, and the switching between them energizes rather than drains you.
* Comfortable selling a new category with no playbook: you create structure, run experiments, and kill what doesn’t work fast.

**Bonus points:** insurtech distribution experience (selling through brokers and direct - think early Vouch, Coalition, Newfront, Embroker) · you’ve sold to AI-native or developer-tool companies · you’ve been a founder.

## **What we offer**

Competitive salary with a meaningful variable component tied to the number you own, plus significant founding-team equity - discussed openly in our first conversation. Full ownership of go-to-market at the ground floor of a new category, working directly with the founders.

title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative
description:
## **About Alex**

Alex is the AI recruiter for hiring great people.

Alex interviews, screens, and schedules every candidate – over voice, video, and text – so talent teams hire more great people, faster, without adding TA headcount. The recruiter stays in control: every shortlist is approved by a human, and every relationship and offer is owned by the customer's team.

We're past 1M+ interviews, integrate with 33+ ATS platforms, and 96% of candidates prefer interviewing with Alex. We're revenue-generating, well-funded, backed by premier investors, and are focused on enterprise customers: selling to VPs of Talent Acquisition, CHROs, and CFOs at large employers who are rethinking how hiring gets done at scale.

## **What we're looking for**

We're hiring an **Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to build pipeline in the enterprise segment. You'll be the first voice enterprise talent leaders hear from Alex, and a primary driver of enterprise revenue growth. You’ll own multi-stakeholder accounts with real hiring volume, procurement processes, and strong talent leaders.

Your day to day will include:

- **Enterprise pipeline generation:** Prospect into named enterprise accounts across phone, email, video, social, and events. Research the account, map the buying committee, and open conversations with senior stakeholders using messaging that speaks to their hiring volume, cost per hire, and enterprise procurement processes.

- **Multi-threaded outbound strategy:** Own the enterprise outbound motion end-to-end – account selection, segmentation, and personalized multi-channel sequences. Partner tightly with Account Executives on account plans, multi-threading across a committee, and hands-on support through pilots and evaluations.

- **Inbound qualification with enterprise judgment:** Qualify inbound demand from marketing, running discovery on fit, hiring volume, urgency, existing ATS stack, and buying process. Route high-intent enterprise interest into qualified opportunities and disqualify quickly and cleanly when it isn't a fit.

- **Fluency in the enterprise buyer's world:** Get sharp fast on TA operating models, ATS ecosystems, and the compliance landscape (EU AI Act, NYC LL144, SOC 2, bias audits). Enterprise buyers ask hard questions early; you'll be credible on how Alex does the work while humans make the decision.

- **Performance & pipeline ownership:** Consistently hit and beat pipeline-generation targets. Track your own metrics, show up prepared for pipeline and forecast reviews, and keep tuning targeting and messaging based on what the market tells you.

- **Data management & tooling:** Run a clean, well-documented process in Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Amplemarket, Nooks, and similar platforms – prospecting, follow-up, and reporting an enterprise AE can build on.

This role is based in office in San Francisco and reports to our SDR Manager.

## **Why join**

- **Ground floor of the enterprise motion:** We're building the enterprise playbook now. What you learn in the first 90 days shapes how Alex sells to enterprise buyers.

- **Exposure:** Work directly with Account Executives, Product, and cross-functional leadership to sharpen enterprise messaging and account strategy.

- **Impact:** Sell a product that changes how people get hired and gives every candidate a real interview instead of a resume screen.

- **Upside:** Competitive compensation, including commission and equity.

- **Benefits:** Healthcare, vision and dental insurance, 401(k), unlimited PTO, beautiful office in SF, company-paid lunches, and great company events.

Learn more at [alex.com](https://www.alex.com).

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
[**Cogram**](https://cogram.com/) is an AI platform for the architecture, engineering, and construction industry. We automate project management with AI agents, such as RFIs & submittals, email filing, field notes, meeting minutes, or reporting. World-leading architecture and engineering firms use Cogram at scale. We’re backed by YC, Initialized, and other leading investors.

The architecture and engineering industry is a $13T market that still runs on email chains, spreadsheets, and manual data entry. We’re building the AI platform that replace that. The problems are seriously hard: messy real-world data, deeply entrenched workflows, and users who need to trust the output on job sites in difficult environments. We’re a small, winning team competing with companies 100x our size. The goal is to become the default AI platform for design and engineering workflows.

### **What you’ll do**

* Book and hold 8+ qualified first meetings per week
* Cold-call
  * **Please note: expect to build pipeline by cold-calling for 3-4 hours / day. If you don’t want to cold-call, this role is not a fit for you.**
* Own your data: every touch logged, every meeting handed off clean 
* Learn the full sale by sitting next to it, with a defined path to a closing AE role in 12–18 months
* Work closely with experienced AEs and Cogram’s founders on scaling the company

### **What we’re looking for**

* 1+ years of SDR experience
* Strong cold-calling skills
* Metrics-driven, sharp communicator, fast learner
* Interest in AI automation; basic technical fluency is a plus

### **Benefits**

* Competitive pay
* Uncapped commission, aggressive accelerators
* 38 paid days off
* 3 off-sites/year

### **Application process**

Apply: email alex - at - cogram - dot - com with subject “Cogram SDR Application” and include:

* **3 bullets on your closing/pipeline track record, for the last 4 quarters:**
  * quota
  * attainment % of quota, and where that ranks you relative to peers
  * how you sourced your leads: average number of calls / week, emails / week, or other

**Process:**

* Initial screen (20 minutes): This will be a virtual intro call for you to get to know us as a team and company, and for us to learn more about you.
* Sales interview (60 minutes)
* Cultural-fit interview (30 minutes): We'll use this interview to determine if we're aligned on values and would work well together as a team.
* Reference calls: we’ll ask you to share 1-2 references—current or former managers—for 10 minute reference calls.
* Offer

description:
\
**At Corgi, we're building the first fully automated insurance carrier.**

\
Our goal is to rebuild the $1T+ insurance industry from the ground up using AI. We're not just building a company; we're building infrastructure for the next hundred years. If you’ve built things from scratch and know what it means to move fast and own outcomes, we want you on the team.

We’re well-funded and backed by top investors, providing the resources you wish you had when building your own business. We don’t care about traditional roles or titles - just that you’re smart, proactive, and bring the same founder-level ownership and drive to help us build something massive.

### 

### About the role

\
This isn’t your typical Business Development role. Most graduates spend years trying to get in front of CEOs. Here, that’s Monday morning. The people you’ll speak to don’t need to take your call. Your job is giving them a reason to. \
\
You’ll spend your time speaking with founders, owners and senior executives across financial services, building relationships and creating conversations that most people at your stage of their career simply wouldn’t have access to.

\
Some conversations last five minutes. Some become something much bigger. Every conversation matters. The best people in this role don’t just create meetings. They create opportunities.\
\
We can teach the process. We can’t teach curiosity, resilience or the ability to earn someone’s attention.

### 

### **What we’re looking for**

\
If you’re looking for a comfortable graduate job, this isn’t it. We’re hiring hard workers and fast learners. We are **in-person** **only** and full-time. The work is challenging, and the hours are long, but we make it worthwhile. New hires and people pursuing the account executive route are required to be in office 6 days a week.

\
If you want responsibility early, exposure to senior decision-makers from day one, and the chance to accelerate your career alongside one of the fastest-growing companies in financial services, we’d like to meet you.

\
Closer to leadership. The path is yours to choose and quick.

\
We want people obsessed with progression. We need results, and fast.

\
You’ll build relationships with executives most people won’t meet for years.

\
Ownership over your pipeline and progression from day one.

\
\
**Requirements and hours:**

* Must have the right to work in the UK, we can’t sponsor visas. Must be able to be in office 6 days a week in London.
* Working hours are US-based, **2pm-10pm Monday to Friday**, **11am-2pm Saturday** (training). We are currently operating in the US market, but this may change to UK hours by the end of 2026 with our Europe expansion.

### 

**Help build what we know will become a $100B+ company.**

\
\
**Compensation**

* Base: £40-50k
* OTE: £10-15k+
* Hit your numbers → move up fast (AE, AM, Ops, or Leadership in 2–6 months)

\
**Interview Process**

1 phone call → 1 simulated work trial → offer.

We move fast, no drawn-out processes and no waiting games.

description:
## About TrueBiz

TrueBiz helps financial institutions identify fraudulent and abusive businesses while making it easier to approve legitimate ones.

We work with some of the largest companies in payments and financial services, but we’re still a lean team. People here have a lot of ownership and very little distance between seeing something that needs to be done and doing it.

Most of our growth to date has come through founder-led sales and referrals. We know who buys TrueBiz, why they buy it, and which companies we want to work with next.

We now want someone to build a much more systematic way of reaching them.

## The role

title: Head of Sales
description:
TrueBiz is a YC-backed merchant risk intelligence platform helping financial institutions understand whether the businesses they serve are legitimate.

We’re at a rare stage as a company: we already work with some of the largest companies in payments and financial services, but we’re still a small team where exceptional people can have an enormous impact on what gets built and how the company develops.

We’ve intentionally stayed lean, moved quickly, and given people much more ownership than they would typically have at a company with our level of enterprise traction. There are very few layers between identifying an important problem and actually solving it.

The mission matters too. Our technology helps stop fraudulent and abusive businesses from gaining access to the financial system, while helping legitimate businesses get approved faster and with less friction.

We’ve gotten this far with a predominantly founder-led sales motion and the beginnings of a repeatable playbook. We’re now looking for a **Head of Sales** to build on that foundation, personally win our next generation of strategic customers, and eventually build a small, exceptional sales team around what works.

## What you'll own

### Sell

* Personally lead and close strategic enterprise opportunities.
* Build relationships with senior risk, fraud, underwriting, compliance, and product leaders.
* Own a meaningful individual pipeline and revenue target.
* Work directly with the CEO on our largest and most strategic accounts.
* Navigate complex sales processes involving product, technical, procurement, security, legal, and executive stakeholders.

### Build the playbook

* Take the sales motion we've already developed and make it significantly better.
* Identify what separates deals that move quickly from those that stall.
* Sharpen qualification, discovery, messaging, account strategy, and deal execution.
* Develop repeatable approaches for breaking into and expanding within large financial institutions.
* Establish a simple and accurate forecasting and pipeline-management cadence.
* Turn founder-led knowledge into a sales process that other strong sellers can execute.

### Build the team

* Coach and develop a lean sales team.
* Determine when additional sales capacity is actually needed.
* Recruit a small number of exceptional sellers rather than building ahead of demand.
* Establish expectations, compensation, territories, and operating cadence.
* Stay directly involved in selling even as the team grows.

We expect the sales organization to remain **lean by design**.

## What we're looking for

We're less interested in a specific title than evidence that you can both **sell and build**.

You are likely someone who:

* Has consistently been a top enterprise seller.
* Has personally closed complex six- and seven-figure B2B deals.
* Has experience creating pipeline rather than relying entirely on inbound demand.
* Knows how to navigate large organizations with multiple stakeholders and long sales cycles.
* Is comfortable hiring slowly and maintaining a high talent bar.
* Is rigorous about pipeline and forecasting without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Wants to remain close to customers and deals rather than becoming a full-time manager.

Experience selling into payments, fintech, fraud, risk, identity, compliance, financial services, or enterprise data is particularly valuable.

## What success looks like

### First 30 days

* Develop a deep understanding of TrueBiz, our customers, existing pipeline, and current sales playbook.
* Join active opportunities and begin taking ownership of deal strategy.
* Build account plans for our highest-priority prospects.
* Understand what has driven our largest wins so far and where our current process breaks down.
* Develop a strong working cadence with the CEO and existing AE.

### First 90 days

* Personally own and advance a meaningful pipeline of strategic opportunities.
* Improve our sales playbook based on firsthand experience selling the product.
* Put in place a simple, reliable qualification and forecasting process.
* Establish a repeatable approach to penetrating our highest-value target accounts.
* Coach the existing AE and create clear standards for how we sell.
* Define what the next 1–2 sales hires should look like and when we should make them.

### Over the following 12 months

* Become a major individual contributor to new revenue.
* Build a small team of exceptional enterprise sellers around you.
* Create a sales motion that generates predictable pipeline and closes large accounts without depending entirely on the CEO.
* Maintain a high revenue-per-salesperson culture as the company grows.

## How we work

TrueBiz is an intentionally lean and experienced team.

You'll have direct access to the CEO, product, and engineering team. Decisions happen quickly, and there are very few layers.

That also means there won't be a large organization around you to solve problems. We expect you to identify what needs to happen and make it happen.

For the right person, that's the opportunity: **take a sales motion that has already produced major enterprise customers, improve it through your own selling, and build the small team that can take it much further.**

title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
description:
# Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. **Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice.** We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading.

# About the Role

We're hiring a Special Projects Lead to take Fleek's new category bets from thesis to proven economics. Each is a new business line that could add £5M+ in GMV, opening a new supply category or a new sourcing geography for the marketplace. Here's what makes these bets unusually winnable. Fleek already owns the demand. Most of the live bets sell to buyers who transact on Fleek today, so they're a supply-first test rather than a two-sided cold start. Your job on a new bet is to find and onboard the supply, sell it into demand that already exists and read the economics fast.

Every bet runs through the same gates. If a bet misses its gates, you kill it with evidence and move to the next one. If it works and you're running it well, you don't have to hand it off. You scale into owning the category, with supply, acquisition and ops building out under you. Think of this seat as a venture builder inside Fleek.

One thing this is not. We're not building a sales team or a sales culture, and this is not an AE or account manager role with a new title. You'll work directly with the founders and our commercial lead, close to the centre of the company.

# What You'll Do

* **Run bets through the gates:** take each bet from market research to first suppliers to first GMV to a feasible-or-not call, with win metrics and kill metrics defined before you start.
* **Go where the supply is:** get on planes. You'll visit suppliers, graders and rag houses in the markets your bets open up, because this trade is built face to face and the best stock never gets listed anywhere.
* **Sell supply into live demand:** onboard brands, brokers, graders and wholesalers, then get Fleek's existing buyers transacting on the new inventory. The sell is fast, informal and relationship-led, over WhatsApp and Instagram as often as in a boardroom.
* **Make the kill calls:** hold a clear view of unit economics and the competitive landscape on every bet. Double down or cut on evidence, not attachment.
* **Be the ops function, for now:** work out importer-of-record structures, duties, freight cost and last mile for each new flow.
* **Ride the AI infrastructure:** our acquisition team has spent months building the agentic outreach and enrichment engine. You'll plug your bets into it and extend it, rather than building from a blank page or adding headcount.
* **Learn the actual trade:** how stock is graded, routed and priced across markets, and who's sitting on good inventory that nobody has approached. You'll get deep in it fast.

# What You Bring

* **Zero-to-one is your natural habitat.** You've built something from nothing as a founder, an early employee or the person who started a new line inside an existing company. You've operated without a playbook and you didn't wait for one.
* **Operator and commercial in one person.** You build the machine and you carry the number. You're not pure strategy and you're not pure sales, and you're comfortable being measured on GMV within your first quarter.
* **AI fluency.** You work with agents and automations daily and you'd rather build a workflow than repeat a task.

**Strong signals on top of that:**

* An instinct for physical goods. You understand inventory, margins and trading relationships, or you've worked around fashion, resale or marketplaces.
* Deals you structured yourself, at any size, that didn't exist before you wrote them.
* Exposure to cross-border trade, logistics or supply chain operations.

**Nice to Have**

* Direct experience in resale, surplus or secondary-market inventory
* Experience launching a new market, geography or product line from scratch
* Established networks in international sourcing markets

# What You'll Get

* Generous equity: being on Fleek means you'll own a part of it
* Comprehensive healthcare coverage
* A collaborative team in a lovely office in the heart of East London
* Access to founders. We're a small team and they're heavily involved (and good fun!)
* Exclusive employee discounts to buy on Fleek
* Access to borrow any item from our collection of vintage and reworks in the office
* A disproportionate level of responsibility and the opportunity to drive massive impact

**How We Work**

Fleek is an in-office company. We're based at Commercial Street, E1 (Liverpool Street / Aldgate East). We operate a fully in-person culture at our office in Shoreditch, with trust-based flexibility. We hire adults and trust them to perform.

**The Practicalities**

* **Location:** London HQ, Commercial Street, E1 (Liverpool Street / Aldgate East)
* **Stage:** Post-Series B, hyper-growth
* **Team:** 200 across three geographies
* **Culture:** High ownership, non-hierarchical, fast-moving. Founder-led with strong opinions loosely held.

# Our Values

Five values shape how we work at Fleek:

* **Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself:** Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach.
* **Absolute Ownership:** The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn't done until the job is done.
* **Curiosity Leads the Way:** Don't accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don't know the answer to. That's how you innovate.
* **Talk to the Customer:** Deeply understand their challenges, motivations, and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre.
* **Embrace Diversity:** A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter.

**Ready to build the infrastructure for the world's fastest-growing fashion economy? If you want to work on genuinely hard problems, with a world-class team, at a company that's tripling annually, we'd love to hear from you.**

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
We're looking for a Sales Development Representative to help turn Casco's founder-led sales momentum into a repeatable outbound engine. You'll start conversations with AppSec leaders and CISOs who know annual pentests and noisy security scanners cannot keep up with how quickly modern teams ship software. Your job is to make the problem urgent, earn the right to a deeper conversation, and create qualified pipeline for Casco's autonomous security testing platform.

This is not a role where you inherit a perfect script and spend all day blasting sequences. You'll work in person with our founders and sales team in San Francisco, learn how technical security buyers think, test messages in the market, and help build the outbound playbook as Casco scales after its Series A.

## What You'll Actually Do

- **Create qualified pipeline:** Research target accounts, identify the right AppSec and security leaders, and turn cold accounts into real sales conversations.
- **Write outbound that sounds human:** Build sharp, account-specific messaging across email, phone, LinkedIn, and other channels instead of hiding behind generic sequences.
- **Learn the security problem:** Understand how companies buy pentests today, where point-in-time testing falls short, and why continuous autonomous testing matters.
- **Qualify for substance:** Find a credible security problem, relevant use case, buying context, and concrete next step before handing an opportunity to an Account Executive.
- **Work events:** Attend security events with the team, start conversations in the room, and follow up fast enough to turn interest into pipeline.
- **Build the playbook:** Test personas, industries, hooks, objections, and channels, then document what works so we can repeat it.
- **Keep the CRM honest:** Record the source, account, persona, meeting outcome, and next step so the team can trust the pipeline and improve the motion.
- **Close the feedback loop:** Share what prospects say with founders, sales, engineering, and security so we keep sharpening the product and the story.

## What We're Looking For

### Must-Haves

- At least one year of outbound SDR or BDR experience in B2B software, with evidence that you can consistently create qualified meetings.
- Strong writing and research skills. You can find a real reason to contact an account and explain it without corporate filler.
- Comfort on the phone. You can open a cold conversation, ask a useful question, listen, and earn a next step.
- The curiosity to learn application security, pentesting, vulnerabilities, cloud environments, APIs, and how technical buyers evaluate new security products.
- Good judgment about quality. You would rather create the right meeting than hit a vanity activity number.
- Resilience and follow-through. You can handle rejection, keep your standards high, and stay organized across a large account set.
- Startup readiness. You are comfortable testing ideas, working without a finished playbook, and making your own progress visible.
- The ability to work in person from our San Francisco office.

### Nice-to-Have

- Experience prospecting into cybersecurity, developer tools, infrastructure, cloud, or another technical category.
- Familiarity with AppSec leaders, security engineers, CISOs, or the pentesting market.
- Experience at an early-stage startup or helping create a new outbound motion.
- A genuine interest in how attackers think and how AI is changing offensive security.

## Your First Three Months

You'll have a three-month ramp to learn Casco, our buyers, and the outbound motion before carrying a full quota.

- **Month 1 — 25% quota:** Learn the product and market, build account lists, practice the story, and begin live prospecting.
- **Month 2 — 50% quota:** Run consistent outbound, handle common objections, and create your first accepted opportunities.
- **Month 3 — 75% quota:** Own a defined account set and build a repeatable weekly pipeline rhythm.
- **Month 4 onward — 100% quota:** Carry the full monthly target.

During the three-month ramp, you'll receive guaranteed variable compensation while you build toward full productivity.

## What This Role Is Not

- This is not a remote role. You will build the motion alongside the team in our San Francisco office.
- This is not an activity contest where a dashboard full of calls matters more than whether anyone should take the meeting.
- This is not a mature sales organization with a finished script, perfect data, and every objection already documented.
- This is not a role for someone who wants to sell a checkbox. You will need to explain why a new approach to security testing should exist.

## What We Offer

- **San Francisco based:** Work in person with our founders, sales team, engineers, and security experts.
- **Compensation:**
  - Base salary: $80,000
  - Target variable: $40,000
  - On-target earnings: $120,000
  - Equity grant with meaningful ownership in Casco
- **Real ownership:** Help build the outbound motion for a new category instead of inheriting someone else's playbook.
- **Direct access:** Learn alongside founders and technical teammates who can answer hard questions and act quickly on market feedback.
- **A product with proof:** Casco has already found critical vulnerabilities across 300+ companies despite their existing security tools and human pentesters.
- **Learning opportunities:** We support your growth with a budget for conferences, books, courses, and the tools that help you improve.

## Our Mission

Casco's mission is to make all software effortlessly secure. We build AI agents that think like attackers and give security teams solutions instead of another pile of noisy alerts.

The time it takes attackers to weaponize vulnerabilities is collapsing, while companies are shipping more software than ever. We believe the only sustainable defense is continuous offense: finding and fixing vulnerabilities before attackers can exploit them.

title: GTM Internship
description:
**Location:** In-person, San Francisco — ASAP\
**Type:** Internship

Overlap builds AI video agents for media companies, creators, podcasts, and streamers. We help teams automatically edit, distribute, and grow the best moments from long-form video and audio.

We work with companies including **iHeartMedia, Barstool Sports, Stripe, Forbes, Yahoo**, and others, alongside some of the largest creators and media brands on the internet.

## The Role

We’re looking for a **GTM Intern** to help us find and reach the next generation of Overlap customers.

You’ll be primarily focused on **lead generation, account sourcing, and outbound** across two major customer groups: large media companies and high-growth creators, including podcasts and streamers.

This is a research-heavy, high-agency role. You’ll identify the right companies and creators, figure out who actually owns the problem we solve, find ways to reach them, and help turn those accounts into sales opportunities.

Our contracts range from traditional SaaS subscriptions to **CPM-based, outcome-driven agreements**, so you’ll learn how to sell both software and measurable business outcomes.

## What You’ll Do

* Source high-potential media companies, creators, podcasts, and streamers
* Build targeted account and prospect lists based on clear customer profiles
* Identify the right decision-makers within larger organizations
* Research prospects deeply enough to understand their content strategy and where Overlap fits
* Find emails, social profiles, warm connections, and other paths into target accounts
* Run and improve outbound campaigns across email, LinkedIn, X, and other channels
* Personalize outreach around each prospect rather than relying on generic sequences
* Work directly with the founders to test new verticals, customer segments, and GTM strategies
* Help maintain and improve our CRM and sales pipeline
* Analyze what sourcing channels and messaging actually convert, then iterate quickly

## What We’re Looking For

* Extremely resourceful and good at finding information online
* Strong written communication skills
* Comfortable reaching out to people you don’t know
* Organized and able to manage large numbers of prospects without losing attention to detail
* Curious about media, creators, podcasts, streaming, and the internet
* Competitive and motivated by measurable results
* High agency — you don’t stop at “I couldn’t find it”
* Comfortable working quickly without perfect instructions
* Willingness to work in-person in San Francisco

## Bonus Points

* Prior sales, business development, recruiting, or lead-generation experience
* Experience with tools like Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, or similar
* Experience building automated prospecting or enrichment workflows
* Deep knowledge of the creator, podcast, streaming, or digital media ecosystem
* You’ve sold something before — software, sponsorships, services, or your own project
* You have unusual ways of finding and getting in touch with hard-to-reach people

## Why Join Overlap

* Learn GTM by selling a product already used by major companies and creators
* Work directly with the founders on real enterprise and creator sales
* Learn how outcome-based and SaaS contracts are structured and sold
* Get exposure to customers ranging from individual creators to major public companies
* Test ideas quickly and see exactly how your work affects pipeline and revenue
* Join a small team where strong performance translates into significantly more responsibility

## Apply

**Show us that you know how to find people.**

We care more about resourcefulness, judgment, and execution than credentials.

title: Director, Sales - UK
description:
### **About Pirros**

Pirros is building the intelligence layer for design production. We are fundamentally reshaping how architecture and engineering firms manage project knowledge and technical design details.

Our platform is an AI-powered hub purpose-built for the AECO industry. We help architects, engineers, and contractors streamline detail management to improve consistency, minimize errors, and accelerate project delivery timelines.

We are establishing the system of record for design production in a global $12T+ market that has been underserved by modern software for far too long.

### **Why Join Pirros**

- Backed by top-tier investors including YC, Funders Club, PlanGrid, and Elephant

- Profitable growth with $7M+ ARR and 10% month-over-month expansion

- Recently secured a $17M Series A in 2025

- Over 350 active firms, including many of the leading AEC organizations nationwide

- Industry-leading 120% net revenue retention (NRR)

- Founding team with deep roots in the structural engineering industry

- Comprehensive compensation including salary, equity, full benefits, and unlimited PTO

- A culture defined by high trust, autonomy, and a team of experienced operators

- The chance to solve high-impact problems for the professionals designing our physical world

### **About the Role**

Pirros is looking for a hands-on Director of Sales to lead and grow our business in the United Kingdom. This person will own Pirros’ UK sales strategy, revenue performance, pipeline development, and market expansion while remaining directly involved in prospecting, customer conversations, demonstrations, negotiations, and closing business.

This is a player-coach role for someone who enjoys building as much as selling. You will lead and develop our UK sales efforts, establish a repeatable and scalable go-to-market approach, and personally support strategic, complex, and high-value opportunities.

You will work closely with Pirros’ U.S. leadership and partner across Marketing, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering to ensure we are effectively serving architecture, engineering, construction, and design firms throughout the UK.

The ideal candidate combines strong SaaS sales leadership with the entrepreneurial mindset required to build a market. You are comfortable operating with autonomy, creating structure where needed, developing relationships across the industry, and staying close to customers and deals.

### **What You’ll Do**

- Own Pirros’ UK sales strategy, revenue plan, pipeline development, and new customer growth

- Lead, coach, and develop the UK sales team as the organization grows

- Carry an individual revenue target and personally lead strategic, complex, and high-value opportunities

- Build pipeline through outbound prospecting, industry relationships, partnerships, events, and marketing programs

- Manage the full sales cycle, from discovery and product demonstrations through negotiation and close

- Navigate multi-stakeholder sales cycles and build relationships with technical users, business leaders, and executive decision-makers

- Establish clear goals, performance expectations, and accountability across the UK sales organization

- Develop accurate forecasts and monitor pipeline coverage, conversion rates, deal velocity, and overall sales performance

- Build and continuously improve the processes, messaging, playbooks, and enablement resources required to scale the UK market

- Partner with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to improve the customer journey and share market insights

- Represent Pirros with customers, prospects, partners, and industry stakeholders throughout the UK

### **What You’ll Own**

- **UK revenue performance** — Consistently meeting or exceeding new business and growth targets

- **Market development** — Expanding Pirros’ presence, reputation, and customer base throughout the UK

- **Pipeline generation** — Maintaining sufficient, high-quality pipeline to support revenue goals

- **Team performance** — Coaching and developing a motivated, accountable, and high-performing UK sales team

- **Strategic opportunities** — Personally driving important, complex, and high-value deals to successful completion

- **Forecasting accuracy** — Providing leadership with a reliable and transparent view of pipeline and expected revenue

- **Sales execution** — Creating a disciplined, repeatable, and scalable approach to winning customers

- **Market intelligence** — Ensuring Pirros understands the needs, priorities, objections, and buying behaviors of UK customers

### **What We’re Looking For**

- Significant full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience, including experience leading or developing salespeople

- A proven track record of meeting or exceeding individual and team revenue targets

- Demonstrated success building pipeline and growing a new market, territory, or regional sales operation

- Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth environment where you helped create processes, structure, and go-to-market strategy

- Strong coaching, leadership, and performance-management capabilities

- Demonstrated ability to manage complex, consultative, and multi-stakeholder sales cycles

- Strong discovery, presentation, demonstration, negotiation, and closing skills

- Experience selling technical workflow, collaboration, document-management, or vertical SaaS products

- Strong forecasting, pipeline-management, and sales-analytics capabilities

- An entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to operate with autonomy in a fast-moving environment

- A value-driven approach focused on customer outcomes, long-term relationships, and solving meaningful business problems

- Experience using platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar sales tools

- Based in or able to work regularly from London office

### **Nice to Have**

- Experience selling software to architecture, engineering, construction, BIM, Revit, or AECO customers

- Strong knowledge of architecture, engineering, design-production, or construction workflows

- Existing relationships within the UK architecture, engineering, construction, or design-technology industries

- Experience launching or scaling the UK operation of a U.S.-based SaaS company

- Experience recruiting and building a regional sales team

At Pirros, we believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Pirros is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation and the specific salary range will be discussed during the hiring process. Actual compensation for an individual may vary depending on skills, performance over time, qualification and experience. In addition to a competitive base salary, the total compensation package also includes equity and benefits.

**About Saturn**

Saturn is a Series A-backed fintech transforming how financial advice is delivered.

We operate in one of the world’s largest industries. Wealth and asset managers oversee more than $100 trillion and generate over $1 trillion in annual revenue, yet much of the infrastructure used to manage that wealth remains fragmented, manual and institution-specific.

Saturn is starting with the productivity and compliance systems used by financial advisers.

**Our story**

Saturn joined Y Combinator in 2024 and became one of the fastest-growing B2B companies in its batch.

We grew organically to a meaningful share of the UK financial advice market before acquiring the legacy leader, one of the industry’s most established compliance rule engine and suitability businesses, in 2025.

That acquisition combined AI-native product engineering with more than two decades of regulatory expertise, proprietary compliance logic and deep industry distribution.

Within two years of launch, Saturn became the leading provider of AI transformation to UK financial advice firms, supporting more than 9,000 regulated advice professionals who manage about $500bn in assets.

We have proved distribution, trust and demand. The most important infrastructure is still ahead of us.

**Your role**

As a Partner, you will build your own book of clients the way the best advisers build a practice: firms you found, won, and advised for years, with Michelin-grade care from the first conversation to long after the signature. You are the single trusted owner of the relationship, and the all-rounder transformation partner your firms plan their future with.

Saturn is a Series A, Y Combinator-backed company building the AI-native operating system for financial advice. Our platform combines a living data model of the client, AI agents that complete complex advice and operational workflows, and compliance logic embedded directly into how work is produced. The initial wedge is adviser productivity. The larger opportunity is rebuilding the operating model of the advice firm around connected data, intelligent workflows and continuous regulatory control.

This is a full-cycle role with end-to-end ownership. And you’re never carrying it alone: you conduct the whole of Saturn behind your book, with teams of experts supporting your firms’ day-to-day queries and running implementation as each firm needs, while you own the relationship, the strategy and the growth. The timing is the opportunity: Saturn is already the market leader, the UK has thousands of firms ready to move, and the playbook is still being written, by the Partners who join now. Your work will determine whether Saturn becomes the foundational platform through which an entire industry operates.

**The Team**

Our Partnerships team is small and high-calibre by design and works the way we expect advisers to serve their clients: with unreasonable care and long-term commitment. Every Partner carries real revenue responsibility and shapes the go-to-market motion rather than executing someone else’s playbook. What they learn in the market becomes how Saturn sells.

**What You’ll Work On**

* **The full cycle for new logo IFAs.** Outbound prospecting, inbound qualification, discovery, demos, POCs, business cases, negotiation and close. Consultative selling, not transactional product pitching.
* **Help transform your clients.** Understand where each firm is trying to go, build a clear view of the journey from today to a modern advice business, and challenge constructively where existing ways of working are holding them back.
* **Lead the client relationship.** Own it end to end. Deep trust with senior stakeholders, clear goals and priorities for every firm, risks surfaced early, difficult moments handled with judgement.
* **Grow the relationship.** More users, more usage, more of the platform: expansion built from real transformation needs and timed to the firm’s rhythm rather than ours, with renewals led early and deliberately.
* **Deliver an exceptional Partner Experience.** Clients feel understood, challenged and well cared for. High standards of communication and follow-through, and trust that holds when things go wrong.
* **Build relationships through community, education and events.** Work with Community and Marketing to bring clients and prospects together, help shape roundtables and events and turn Saturn into a place the industry comes to learn.
* **Orchestrate Saturn around the client.** Pull Implementation, Support, Product, Engineering, Design and Finance in at the right moment, give them real context, and make sure internal ambiguity never becomes a client problem.
* **Maintain commercial discipline.** A healthy pipeline, accurate forecasts the business can plan against, clear next steps on every opportunity, and account plans that mean no deal or relationship drifts.
* **Build your personal brand and industry credibility.** Develop your own point of view on how advice should evolve, and become someone firms want to speak with because of your judgement, built in person through UK travel and industry events.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Commercial ownership.** Experience owning relationships and outcomes end to end: a commercial seat where results were yours to win or lose, and you can show what you won.
* **Hunter’s instinct.** You create opportunities rather than wait for them, and you’re comfortable putting yourself in front of people who have never heard of you.
* **Relationships that outlast the deal.** You build trust quickly, and it survives problems and hard conversations. Clients from years ago would still take your call.
* **The judgement to challenge.** You can tell a senior stakeholder something they don’t want to hear and have them thank you for it, without overpromising to win short-term revenue.
* **You know what it takes to win.** Deals earned through preparation, persistence and genuine care. Even the firms that said no would still refer you.
* **Proven learning speed.** You pick up new domains quickly, grow into bigger responsibility, and get sharper with every move.
* **Long-term thinking.** You seek out demanding environments and stay the course long enough to see your work pay off.
* **Operating discipline.** A busy pipeline, competing priorities and a forecast others plan against, organised enough that nothing gets lost between functions.

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with the UK IFA and wealth management landscape
* Background in FinTech or B2B SaaS selling into regulated industries
* An unconventional route into commercial work. Some of our best people did something else first

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary with regular appraisals
* Competitive equity package at an early stage company with high growth potential
* Our beautiful new five-floor office, “The Dome”, equipped with an onsite gym and roof terrace
* Best-in-class dental and medical insurance
* A dedicated budget for learning and professional development
* Access to an additional world-class gym and wellness centre two minutes from the office
* Work on genuinely hard problems at the intersection of fintech, regulation, and AI
* High ownership and autonomy: you are building the foundation of a company with a path to 50x revenue growth
* A tight-knit, ambitious team that cares deeply about quality and each other
